title: P18-B business portfolio — owner-scoped projection over canonical objective_relation
description: P18-B: ObjectivePortfolioService.businessPortfolio — READ-ONLY advisory projection, zero writes reachable. Same owner-scope contract as company cockpit: actor derived from x-operator-id at the edge; only objectives the actor owns in the business are projected (strict scope proof via new ObjectiveAuthorityService.strictEnumerate — persisted-key entityPage enumeration + strict get + payload-identity check, org-wide fail-closed); actor owning none → FAIL_CLOSED_PORTFOLIO_SCOPE (403, code-only). Only proven relations whose BOTH endpoints are owned enter the projection (proven edges are bilaterally owner-scoped; the filter is the honest local check). Per-objective: depends_on/dependents/conflicts/supersedes/superseded_by edge lists (all states, code-unit relation_id order) + dependency summary (ACTIVE upstream → SATISFIED iff upstream ACHIEVED, PENDING non-terminal, FAILED terminal non-ACHIEVED; blocked = pending+failed>0) + active_conflicts. Edges/counts computed over the FULL scoped set before objective truncation (honest totals like cockpit). Deterministic, bounded (200 objectives). Route GET /api/vnext/businesses/:id/portfolio inside store.withReadBudget(1024/512). objective-cockpit.businessCompany refactored onto strictEnumerate (same proof, code becomes FAIL_CLOSED_OBJECTIVE_IDENTITY; UI gloss updated). Advisory only: no admission/scheduling/execution consumer — P18-C consumes upstreamOf/conflictsWith server-side. Codex-only.
